Implement an asynchronous AXI-Stream FIFO.

s_clk and m_clk are independent clocks. Please take care of any clock-domain crossings between them. The resets are active-high.

Buffer stream beats between the two sides without disturbing their order, packet endings, or enabled sidebands. Full, empty, and depth use acknowledged binary pointer snapshots, so ready can lag. Hold tdata and tlast while tready is low. Honor the selected full, pause, and drop/mark options.

Revised behavior (benchmark v2):
Additional transfer latency and bubbles spanning multiple receiving-clock edges are permitted. Preserve ordered, exactly-once accepted transfers, the stated capacity, and stable valid data while stalled. There is no one-beat-per-clock throughput guarantee.
